exposure: myometrial thickness at the uterine scar
blood flow signal around the gestational sac
outcome: hemorrhage during hysteroscopic curettage for cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP)
cohort: A total of 338 women diagnosed with cesarean scar pregnancy (CSP) undergoing hysteroscopic curettage were included.
finding: Key high-risk factors for hemorrhage during hysteroscopic curettage for CSP include longer duration of amenorrhea, larger gestational sac length, thinner myometrial thickness at the uterine scar, and specific blood flow signals around the gestational sac.
gest_age: duration of amenorrhea (<49 days) and gestational sac length (<30 mm) were used as criteria for safe procedure, indicating an assessment related to gestational age at the time of the procedure.
